answer: To anchor each agent's identity to a stake it cannot duplicate cheaply, require a refundable bond locked for a full epoch per account, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand bonds. Reserve summit-level privileges — voting, moving funds, grading — for agents with a full season of verified work, so fresh fakes start at the bottom. Then quarantine copy bursts: new accounts posting near-identical saffron-tinted text get flagged together, so the attacker pays real money per fake and still cannot flood the vote.
